features: Long-Range 100M HDMI Transmission – Wirelessly extend your HDMI signal up to 100 meters (328ft) in open space using 5GHz frequency. Perfect for conference rooms, home theaters, or outdoor events.
1080P Full HD Wireless Video – Supports crystal-clear 1080P @60Hz HDMI output for lag-free streaming of video and audio from your laptop, CCTV DVR, camera, or set-top box.
Plug & Play – No App or Software Needed – Easy to set up with auto-pairing. Just plug the HDMI transmitter into your device and the receiver into your TV or projector.
Stable Signal with Dual Antenna – Equipped with high-performance dual antennas for strong wireless signal and uninterrupted performance, even through walls.
Wide Compatibility – Works with laptops, PCs, set-top boxes, CCTV DVRs, Blu-ray players, gaming consoles (PS4, Xbox), projectors, and TVs.
description: Upgrade your home or office setup with the Hi-Focus 100M Wireless HDMI Extender, a powerful wireless HDMI transmitter and receiver kit that eliminates messy cables while delivering smooth 1080P Full HD video and audio. Using a 5GHz high-speed wireless signal, this HDMI over WiFi extender transmits content from your source device (like a laptop, CCTV DVR, or gaming console) to any HDMI-enabled display (TV, monitor, projector) up to 100 meters in open environments. Designed for plug & play ease, there's no software, app, or drivers required. The dual antenna design ensures stable, lag-free transmission, making it ideal for both professional presentations and home entertainment. Whether you're watching movies, streaming games, or conducting business presentations, this wireless HDMI adapter for TV delivers exceptional performance in a sleek, compact design.
